title: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes vulnerability in… (CVE-2026-114573)
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-114573 affects the Monster Menus module for Drupal. It involves improperly controlled modification of dynamically-determined object attributes, which can lead to object injection. The affected versions range from 0.0.0 up to 9.5.6. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
